purpose: Throw: fibre micro-relief and micro-roughness only. The regular seed/moss-stitch lattice (beads, knit cells, plied twist, tone) is explicit procedural geometry in prepare_bedroom_fabrics.py; from this scan only the Displacement and Roughness high-pass (structure below ~1.5 mm) is used, tiled 2x2 at 0.8x size on the 0.48 m tile, at 0.10 mm height std. Native orange chroma discarded; Color, NormalGL and AmbientOcclusion are retained as the verified source set but no longer drive visible structure. Individual CC0 texture maps only, never a room/model.
